# Legacy technique IDs

<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py from playbook frontmatter. Do not edit by hand. -->

Enterprise ATT&CK **v19.2** revoked 149 technique IDs. Detection content written against older ATT&CK versions still carries the old IDs in its tags, and search engines still index them, so this table exists to make migration mechanical rather than archaeological.

## IDs relevant to this library

These revoked IDs map to techniques this library covers. If your existing rules are tagged with the legacy ID, they describe the same behaviour as the playbook listed.

## Tactic restructure

ATT&CK v19 replaced the single Defense Evasion tactic with two:

| Current tactic | ID | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| Stealth | TA0005 | Blending in and avoiding observation (proxy execution, obfuscation, masquerading) |
| Defense Impairment | TA0112 | Degrading the defences themselves (disabling tools, clearing logs) |

Content tagged `attack.defense-evasion` is not wrong, only outdated: map it to whichever of the two tactics matches the behaviour it detects.
